week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 14.0 percentage points apart on Dallas at Green Bay.

rest.headline: San Francisco projects to 13.5 wins, the most in the league.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Chicago's playoff chances fell the most this week, to 27%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 15%.
